source.title: Call for Applicants - WAC Leader (February 2021)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Advisory Council (WAC) Leader**. The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered. 

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the Council. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Good knowledge of the WCA structure
* A strong connection to the WCA Community

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **March 24th, 2021, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WAC can be found in [WCA Motion 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 4.1 of [WCA Motion 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 顾问委员会负责人招募（2021 年 2 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的**顾问委员会（WAC）负责人**。申请面向所有 WCA 成员开放，无须目前已在组织中任职。

申请人应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周为委员会工作至少 5 小时。我们希望申请人具备以下条件：

* 较强的领导能力。
* 出色的沟通能力。
* 熟悉 WCA 的组织架构。
* 与 WCA 社区保持密切联系。

申请材料提交时间为即日起至 **2021 年 3 月 24 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请将申请私下发送给 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

<!-- break -->

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
* 担任 WCA 顾问委员会负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料。

WAC 的权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 20.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将依据 [WCA 决议 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf)第 4.1 节投票选定并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
